question: Which of the following is the largest stupa in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kesariya**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kesariyais **the largest stupa in India.
 
• Kesariya stupa was under the rule of Mauryan and Lichchavis during ancient times.
 
• The current stupa is believed to date back to the **Gupta Dynasty.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• Buddhist architecture consists of Chaityas, Viharas, Stupas and Stambhas.
 
• This architecture developed in the Indian subcontinent.
 
 
• Chaitya refers to temples, shrines or discussion hall for assemblies and Viharas were for the purpose of living.
 
• Chaityas were having stupas in it and Viharas were not.
 
• Both Chaitya and Viharas were made of wood and later period by stone-cut architecture. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Dhamek Stupa **which is also spelled as Dhamekh and Dhamekha is one of the most famous and Buddhist stupas located in Sarnath near Varanasi in Uttar Pradesh, India.
 
• **Amaravati Stupa** is situated in the Guntur district of Andhra Pradesh.
 
 
• It was built by Ashoka in 3 century B.C. 
 
 
 
• Alexander Cunningham discovered the **'Bharhut Stupa'** in the year 1873 A.D. Key Points Bharhut Stupa It is locate.
